parameters.description: Name of input visibility file
parameters.name: vis

parameters.description: Name of output gain calibration table
parameters.name: caltable

parameters.description: Time offset (sec) between interferometric and WVR data
parameters.name: toffset

parameters.description: Do a new coefficient calculation for each source
parameters.name: segsource

parameters.description: Regard the WVR data for these source(s) as bad and do not produce corrections for it (requires segsource=True)
parameters.name: sourceflag

parameters.description: Prioritise tieing the phase of these sources as well as possible (requires segsource=True)
parameters.name: tie

parameters.description: Number of solutions for phase correction coefficients (nsol>1 requires segsource=False)
parameters.name: nsol

parameters.description: Apply correction for dispersion
parameters.name: disperse

parameters.description: Regard the WVR data for these antenna(s) as bad and replace its data with interpolated values from neighbouring antennas
parameters.name: wvrflag

parameters.description: Compute the statistics (Phase RMS, Disc) on this field only
parameters.name: statfield

parameters.description: Compute the statistics (Phase RMS, Disc) on this source only
parameters.name: statsource

parameters.description: Smooth calibration solution on the given timescale
parameters.name: smooth

parameters.description: Scale the entire phase correction by this factor
parameters.name: scale

parameters.description: List of the spectral window IDs for which solutions should be saved into the caltable
parameters.name: spw

parameters.description: List of the spectral window IDs from which the WVR data should be taken
parameters.name: wvrspw

parameters.description: Reverse the sign of the correction for the listed SPWs (only needed for early ALMA data before Cycle 0)
parameters.name: reversespw

parameters.description: Estimate the continuum (e.g., due to clouds) (experimental)
parameters.name: cont

parameters.description: maximum distance (m) of an antenna used for interpolation for a flagged antenna
parameters.name: maxdistm

parameters.description: minimum number of near antennas (up to 3) required for interpolation
parameters.name: minnumants

parameters.description: If the fraction of unflagged data for an antenna is below this value (0. to 1.), the antenna is flagged.
parameters.name: mingoodfrac

parameters.description: derive the antenna AZ/EL values from the FIELD rather than the POINTING table
parameters.name: usefieldtab

parameters.description: use the WVR data from this antenna for calculating the dT/dL parameters (can give ranked list)
parameters.name: refant

parameters.description: subtract the temperature offsets in this table from the WVR measurements before calculating the phase corrections
parameters.name: offsetstable

parameters.description: random seed for fitting routine, 0 == use internal default
parameters.name: rseed
